label: WaterTAP ASM1 Clarifier-Only RAS
request: Build and solve the WaterTAP ASM1 five-reactor train with conventional clarifier-only return activated sludge. Route all R5 effluent to the secondary clarifier, return only clarifier underflow through the RAS pressure boundary, retain a waste-activated-sludge purge, and set direct R5 recycle to zero by continuation. Report NH4-N, NO3-N, soluble inorganic N, RAS ratio, HRT, WAS flow, oxygen transfer, estimated aeration energy, and hydraulic closure.
